name: Hear

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Listens to the people around you through the glasses microphones so their words can be shown as captions. Audio is streamed to Soniox for recognition only while captions are on; nothing is recorded or stored.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Alternative to the glasses microphones, for example with the phone on a table in a larger room.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends live audio to Soniox (stt-rt.soniox.com) for captions and translation and, with read-aloud on, the translated text to Soniox (tts-rt.soniox.com) for speech, using your own Soniox key. With a Claude key, a tap on the glasses sends recent captions to Anthropic (api.anthropic.com) for an answer.

tagline: Live captions + translation. Needs Soniox key
